profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in software/firmware development in the aerospace and oil & gas industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in Embedded Programming, C & C++, Sales, Management, Marketing Strategy, and Training.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Provide solutions for the company's  Measurement While Drilling Projects.
- Program, design and enhance software for the company's family of instruments.
- Develop PC software using C++ language in Visual Studio 2019. 
- Develop embedded software using C language in Codewarrior.
- Program NXP Embedded Micro-controllers. 
- Develop windows based applications using MFC.
- Participate in the overall design outcome of future software/hardware projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Program, design and enhance software for the company's family of instruments.
- Develop code using C and C++ language in AtmelStudio. 
- Program Atmel Embedded Micro-controllers. 
- Participate in the overall design outcome of future hardware projects.

positions.title: Information Systems Developer
positions.description:
-Develop and deployed SQL within an Incident Lifecycle Management tracking application as well as do improvements, and updates as required.
-Oversee migration of code through the agile software development methodology
-Developed and manage regression testing plans for internal development.
-Analyze/Program code within Sapiens Emerge programming software to modify, update and fix rule code for system productivity.
-Develop within Emerge Software using SQL and proprietary sapiens code (Quix).

positions.title: Information Systems Consultant
positions.description:
-Enhances existing systems using life cycle management methodologies
-Analyzes/submits fixes to program developers
-Researched and developed solutions to application program malfunctions 
    * Using: DBII table management
    * SQL Database administration
    * Code updates 
-Performs well in fast-paced environment; accepts/prioritizes multiple work packages

positions.title: HP Account Sales Representative
positions.description:
Job Duties: 
-Drive product sales through customer interaction.
-Maintain positive relations with store Managers and Retail Sales Representatives. 
-Educate sales associates on key product advantages to better serve customer needs. 
-Demonstrate product at retail stores, store trainings, and internal merchandising meetings. 
-Maintain a sound knowledge of consumer electronic products.
 -Increase revenue by expanding visibility of product and promoting special events. 
-Report daily inventory and sales to manager through online reports.

positions.title: Account Sales Representative
positions.description: -Nokia, AMD, and Sharp retail account sales, training and merchandising.
